newsitem.title: UK: Rank slips as statement disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Rank slips as statement disappoints.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc slipped on Thursday on profit-taking after a long-awaited trading statement from the leisure group fell short of some expectations, dealers said.
By 0840 GMT the stock was down 11p at 431. The shares were bid higher earlier in the week on expectations of a positive trading statement from the leisure group.

"We had such a good run ahead of the statement. But I don't think there's anything exciting in there that justifies prices around the 440p level so it has to come off around 10p," one market maker said.
Rank said it had disposed of peripheral businesses worth over 200 million stg since the half year and added that it expected to take restructuring charges.
The group said its provision for its previously-annnounced restructuring plans in 1996 would be around 35 million stg, most of which would be spent next year.
"In a year of transition, we are making good trading and strategic progress," said chief executive Andrew Teare.
